## About
D&G Landscaping & Design is family-owned and operated, based right here in Houston. We believe every homeowner deserves an outdoor space that fits the way they live, and we take a personal approach to every yard we work on.
Our journey has been one of hard work and faith, and we are grateful for the trust our clients place in us. From simple cleanups to complete outdoor transformations, we work with you from concept to completion.
Our customers give us a 4.5 rating from 55 Google reviews, and they often mention Luis by name, along with a crew that shows up on time and leaves the yard cleaner than they found it.

## Services
- Landscape Design & Installation: We plan your yard around soil conditions, sun exposure and your style, then choose plants, trees and flowers that suit your home. We also add stone pathways and garden beds.
- Hardscaping: Patios, walkways, retaining walls, fire pit areas and decorative stone features, built with natural stone, brick, pavers and concrete.
- Irrigation & Drainage Solutions: Custom sprinkler systems with timers and sensors, plus French drains and grading to move excess water away from your home.
- Outdoor Lighting: Custom lighting that highlights your home, lights up pathways and makes the backyard feel inviting at night, including energy-efficient LED options.
- Seasonal Cleanups: Spring and winter cleanups: removing debris, trimming overgrown plants, refreshing mulch, fertilizing and aerating. One-time deep cleans or routine maintenance.
- Mulching & Sod Installation: Mulch for moisture retention and weed control, and sod laid over properly prepared soil for a green lawn right away.
- Artificial Turf: A green lawn year-round with no watering, mowing or fertilizing. A good fit for backyards, play areas and pet-friendly spaces.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free quotes?
A: Yes. Reach out and ask for a free quote, and we will come talk through your yard with you.

Q: My yard floods when it rains. Can you help?
A: Yes. We install French drains and grading to redirect excess water away from your home. One customer had us replace old drain pipes with new PVC drain lines and catch basins on both sides of the house.

Q: Can you restore a yard after other construction?
A: We can. One reviewer had us restore their yard after pool construction, and Luis and the team worked through the unexpected problems along the way.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM, and Saturday, 8:30 AM to 3:00 PM. We are closed on Sunday.
